approaches.title: Greedy coin selection
approaches.summary: Sorts coins and repeatedly takes the largest coin that does not exceed the remaining amount. This strategy is incorrect for general coin systems, as marked in revision 1.

revisions.commitComment: why do i keep making this mistake
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 322!: why do i keep making this mistake
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduced a descending greedy strategy that repeatedly chooses the largest usable coin and returns the count if the amount reaches zero.

approaches.title: Recursive depth-first search
approaches.summary: Explores possible coin combinations recursively, trying each coin and returning the first successful combination. Sorting changes traversal order but does not make the first solution optimal, as marked in revision 2.

revisions.commitComment: no memo yet, but algo performs dfs which even with sorting doesn't gurantee best case
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 322!: no memo yet, but algo performs dfs which even with sorting doesn't gurantee best case
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaced greedy selection with recursive DFS over remaining amounts and tried larger coins first, but returned the first feasible result without minimizing across alternatives.

approaches.title: Breadth-first search
approaches.summary: Treats each remaining amount as a graph state and explores states level by level. The first visit to amount zero yields the minimum number of coins, while a hash set prevents revisiting states.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Changed recursive search to BFS over remaining amounts, tracking visited states and using the search depth as the number of coins.

approaches.title: Bottom-up dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Builds the minimum coin count for every amount from zero through the target using previously computed subproblems. It stores unreachable states as None and takes the minimum over all usable coins.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 322: bottom-up dp is so hard
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaced BFS with bottom-up DP, initializing amount zero to zero and updating each amount with the best result from subtracting one coin.
